script_text: Neptune's mist meets Saturn's harsh reality this week, pulling this Water sign between dreams and duties. Wednesday brings a Pluto square in the 7th House, sparking power struggles that test partnerships. Wednesday night, Venus moves into the 5th House, shifting romance from turmoil to creative joy. From Thursday, a Neptune sextile to your natal Sun eases tension and fuels artistic projects. The weekend brings a Scorpio Moon opposite your 2nd House, boosting financial instincts while cautioning spending. Tuesday is your power day as Jupiter's trine to Mercury lifts misunderstandings and fuels love breakthroughs. Wednesday is your challenge day as Pluto's square to the 7th House ignites intense relational power plays. Practice a short morning meditation each day to ground Neptune's visions and stay productive. Follow for daily updates.
